claims.text: The resort is on the remote Laamu Atoll in the southern Maldives, a seaplane flight away from Male.

findings.quote: It’s the only five-star resort on the remote Laamu Atoll in the southern Maldives, an awe-inspiring scenic seaplane flight away from Male.
findings.note: Covers the remote Laamu Atoll, the southern Maldives and the seaplane flight from Male.

claims.text: The resort is on Olhuveli Island.

findings.note: The contact address lists Olhuveli Island, Laamu Atoll.

claims.text: All villas make the most of natural materials and are designed for space and privacy.

findings.quote: All make the most of natural materials, and their clever design allows for the utmost space and privacy.
findings.note: Matches the claim about natural materials, space and privacy.

claims.text: Surf pros from Tropicsurf offer a surf package for beginners.

findings.quote: Let the surf pros from Tropicsurf help you ride the waves. Blending board action with island relaxation, this is the perfect surf package for beginners.
findings.note: Tropicsurf pros and a surf package for beginners are both stated.

claims.text: Dolphins, rays and parrotfish swim along the resort's shores.

findings.quote: Our resident dolphins, rays and parrotfish swim along the seashell dappled-shores of the only resort in the Laamu Atoll.
findings.note: Dolphins, rays and parrotfish are all named.

claims.text: The Sunset Dolphin Cruise is on a private dhoni.

findings.quote: Step onto your private dhoni, glass of bubbly in hand, for an emotional cruise
findings.note: Appears under the Sunset Dolphin Cruise heading.

claims.text: Coral gardens lie a stone's throw from the Chill Lounge & Bar.

findings.quote: Pristine coral gardens lie just a stone’s throw from our Chill Lounge & Bar

claims.text: The reef at the resort glows with coral spawning when the moon cycle is right.

findings.quote: When the moon cycle is just right, the reef at Six Senses Laamu glows with an incredible natural phenomenon: coral spawning.

claims.text: Guests choose an over-water villa or a beachfront villa among lush vegetation.

findings.quote: Choose the soft breezes of an over-water villa or hide among the lush vegetation of a beachfront villa.

claims.text: Guests can snorkel the house reef and surf the Yin Yang break.

findings.quote: How about a morning snorkel on our vibrant house reef followed by an afternoon riding the famous Yin Yang break?
findings.note: Covers both house reef snorkeling and the Yin Yang break.

claims.text: The Maldives Underwater Initiative, a marine conservation initiative, is based at the resort in collaboration with The Manta Trust, Blue Marine Foundation and Olive Ridley Project.

findings.quote: Award-winning marine conservation initiative based right here at Six Senses Laamu in collaboration with three partner NGOs: The Manta Trust, Blue Marine Foundation and Olive Ridley Project
findings.note: Establishes the resort base and all three partners.
